description: The bar chart titled “Recall@10” illustrates Recall@10 values for four methods/conditions. The horizontal axis contains the category labels “Ours,” “- critiquing,” “- scoring,” and “- ranking,” shown in that left-to-right order with labels angled; no explicit x-axis label is shown. The vertical axis is a linear numeric scale ranging from 0.1 to 0.4 with tick marks at 0.1 intervals, representing the Recall@10 metric. There are four vertical bars: “Ours” is colored orange and reaches approximately 0.35; “- critiquing” is blue at about 0.29; “- scoring” is blue at about 0.17; and “- ranking” is blue at about 0.235. The bars are not stacked or grouped beyond being placed side-by-side, and there is no legend; the “Ours” bar is visually emphasized by its distinct orange color while the others share the same blue color.
